name: Spark
description: a will-o'-the-wisp: one tiny floating ball of bright yellow-white fire, with two black dot eyes and an angry little mouth inside the flame, a few sparks trailing behind it

poses.stand: darting through the air, flame streaming back
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: fizzling out into a puff of smoke

move.action: zips forward to the right, flame streaming back, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers

prompts.standFromText: Paint {description}. Seen from the side, small and centered in the frame with lots of empty space around it. It is a ball of fire that floats in the air by itself. {style} {background}
prompts.pose: Image 1 is {description}. Show this exact same object, the same design, {action}. Keep its shape, colors, size and position in the frame and the painterly art style of image 1. {background}

style: Painterly digital painting in the style of dark fantasy video game art: soft visible brush strokes, rich shading, gritty and detailed, warm hellfire rim light, high resolution and smooth (not pixel art, not a cartoon).
